bio.text: John Kennedy was elected to the U.S. Senate from Louisiana in 2016 and reelected in 2022.
Before the Senate he served five terms as Louisiana state treasurer, was secretary of the Louisiana Department of Revenue, and was special counsel to Gov. Buddy Roemer.
He graduated from Vanderbilt University, received a law degree from the University of Virginia, and earned a Bachelor of Civil Law from Oxford University.
He grew up in Zachary, Louisiana, and lives in Madisonville.
